description: Tanzania Power Plants is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Power system and utilities", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). Data for power plants in Tanzania with total installed generating capacity 10 mw from the Platts World Electric Power Plants Database (WEPP 2006). Coverage: Tanzania. It has 2 files in CSV, ZIP. The portal files it under Power system and utilities. The portal gives 2009 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
